map.戒指尺寸对照表 使用指南: Ring Size Reference Table User Guide
map.列出各国戒指圈号与内周长/直径的对照，输入已知尺寸查对应尺码，方便网购选号与改圈: Lists ring sizes by country against inner circumference and diameter, so entering a known size gives the matching ring size. It helps with online shopping and resizing, as a pure front-end lookup table.
map.用软尺量指围算直径，对照圈号。: Measure the finger circumference with a soft tape and convert it to a diameter, then match it against the size chart.
map.不同国家尺码体系互转。: Convert between the sizing systems of different countries.
map.指围 55mm 对应直径: The diameter corresponding to a 55 mm finger circumference
map.：直径 = 周长 ÷ π = 55 ÷ 3.14159 ≈ 17.5mm。港码约: Diameter = circumference ÷ π = 55 ÷ 3.14159 ≈ 17.5mm. The Hong Kong code is about size 14 (inner diameter 17.5mm) and the European code is usually labelled 55.
map.下午量更准: The afternoon reading is more accurate
map.：手指早晚/冷热胀缩约 ±0.5 号；建议下午温暖时量，取略紧不脱落为准，宽版戒: Fingers swell and shrink by about ±0.5 size between morning and evening and with temperature; measure in the warm afternoon and aim for slightly tight so it does not slip off, and add half a size for wide bands.
map.港码和欧码怎么对？: How do the Hong Kong code and the European code correspond?
map.欧码多直接标内圈周长(mm，如 55)；港码=内圈直径(mm)−? 约 14 号: The European code usually labels the inner circumference directly in mm (such as 55); the Hong Kong code is the inner diameter (mm), where size 14 corresponds to about 17.5 mm. Brands vary, so rely on the measured inner diameter.
map.→ 打开戒指尺寸对照表工具: → Open the Ring Size (free · browser-only · no data uploads)
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入内容不上传服务器；结果为按上述口径得到的理论估算值。实际应: This tool runs entirely in the browser and does not upload inputs. Results are theoretical estimates using the method above. Actual use depends on equipment parameters, measurement conditions and local standards; refer to equipment nameplates, test reports and current standards, and consult professionals for major decisions.
map.把指围（内周长）换算成内直径，并在 44–70 mm 参考表内匹配中国港码、美码: Convert a finger circumference to inner diameter and match it against a 44–70 mm reference table for Hong Kong, US, UK, JP and EU sizes. Outside that range it asks you to re-measure or consult a jeweller rather than extrapolating from the end points.
map.输入周长或直径即可换算。表内按真实相邻档位取最近号；与最近档相差超过 1 mm: Enter a circumference or diameter. Within the table the nearest real row is used; if the gap to that row exceeds 1 mm, the two closest rows are listed with their actual circumferences for trying on. A diameter input is matched at full precision and rounded only for display.
map.用软尺量指围算直径，在本表 44–70 mm 参考范围内对照圈号。: Measure the finger circumference with a soft tape and match it within this 44–70 mm table.
map.不同国家尺码体系互转；超出参考范围时只提示实测/咨询，不做端点外推。: Convert between national sizing systems; outside 44–70 mm the page only advises re-measuring or consulting a jeweller and does not extrapolate.
map.：例如 75 mm 已超出本表范围，页面不再推荐端点圈号，而提示重新实测或咨询商: : For example, 75 mm is outside this table, so the page no longer recommends an end-point size and instead asks you to re-measure or consult a jeweller. When two rows are more than 1 mm apart, the two nearest actual circumferences are shown for trying on.
map.本表是常见对照，地区标准与品牌版型存在差异；宽版戒、关节明显偏粗等情况应加半号或: This table is a common reference; regional standards and brand lasts differ. Add half a size for wide bands or prominent knuckles, or follow the jeweller's measured size. Use the result as size guidance, not as a custom-order specification.
map.为什么不能按端点外推？: Why not extrapolate from the end points?
map.不同地区标准和品牌版型差异很大，端点外的圈号没有本表依据，按最近档位硬推可能明显: Regional standards and brand lasts vary widely, and sizes beyond the table have no basis here. Snapping to the nearest end row can be clearly too tight or too loose, so re-measure or have the jeweller confirm against the measured inner diameter.
map.量不出内径怎么办？: What if I cannot measure the inner diameter?
map.用细线绕手指一圈量周长最稳：剪一条无弹性细线绕指根一周，在重叠处做记号后拉直量长: A thin, non-stretch string is the most reliable method: wrap it once around the base of the finger, mark the overlap, straighten it and measure the length in mm — that is the circumference, and inner diameter = circumference ÷ π. Measure in the evening when the finger is thickest, at the base rather than the knuckle; if the knuckle is clearly wider, use a value between the two so the ring is neither too tight nor too loose.
